paragraphs.text: Dee Kay is a legendary zombie employee who works at the Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun in the Un-iverse .

Dee Kay is a female zombie with purple hair who works as a Finder of the Lost at the Astrotorium of Fun. Her name is a play on the word "decay." The park rules state that petting beebles is allowed, but may lead to loss of wallet, keys, or fingers. Lost fingers can be reclaimed by seeing Dee Kay at the lost and found.
